");--navy:#0a2f76;--navy2:#061e50;--royal:#2459b8;--gold:#d7aa39;--gold2:#f4db82;--paper:#f5f8fc;--ink:#12264a;--muted:#66758c;--line:#d8e2ef;--green:#2f8b5d;--greenBg:#edf8f2;--shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(6,35,83,.15);--serif:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;--sans:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}body{overflow:hidden}button,a,input,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}img{display:block;max-width:100%}
.app{height:100dvh;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%,rgba(36,89,184,.12),transparent 27%),radial-gradient(circle at 90% 80%,rgba(215,170,57,.10),transparent 25%),linear-gradient(180deg,#eef4fb,#f9fbfe 46%,#eef4fb)}
/* brand header: composited into the same navy field */
.brand{position:relative;background:var(--navy);height:132px;overflow:hidden;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold);isolation:isolate}
